name: Almutawa - Office Email Assistant (Outlook triage)
description: Every 10 minutes: reads new emails in the office Outlook inbox, triages each with AI using the owner's work playbook rules, logs it in processed_emails, adds an inbox notification (doorbell for non-low), creates tasks when needed, and saves reply drafts i

parameters.query: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x.id), '[]'::json) AS new_ids FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb) AS x(id) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processed_emails p WHERE p.message_id = x.id)

SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'title', title, 'when', when_text, 'action', action_text, 'priority', priority) ORDER BY id), '[]'::json) AS rules FROM work_playbook WHERE active AND scope IN ('email', 'general')

WITH p AS (INSERT INTO processed_emails (message_id, received_at, sender, subject, category, importance, summary, matched_rule, action_taken) VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2,'')::timestamptz, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, NULLIF($8,'')::int, $9) ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING message_id), a AS (INSERT INTO approvals (request_type, summary, details, requested_by, channel) SELECT 'email_reply', $15, jsonb_build_object('message_id', $1, 'to', $17, 'subject', $4, 'draft', $16), 'email_assistant', 'inbox' FROM p WHERE $16 <> '' RETURNING id), t AS (INSERT INTO tasks (title, description, status, priority, assigned_to, created_by, due_at, related_entity, related_id, received_at, estimated_minutes, plan, source) SELECT $10, $7, CASE WHEN $16 <> '' THEN 'waiting_approval' ELSE 'open' END, CASE WHEN $6 = 'low' THEN 'low' WHEN $6 IN ('high','urgent') THEN $6 ELSE 'normal' END, 'mohamed', 'email_assistant', COALESCE(NULLIF($11,'')::date + time '14:00', NULLIF($2,'')::timestamptz + make_interval(days => CASE WHEN $6 IN ('high','urgent') THEN 1 ELSE 3 END)), 'email', $1, COALESCE(NULLIF($2,'')::timestamptz, now()), NULLIF($13,'')::int, NULLIF($14,''), 'email' FROM p WHERE $12 = 'true' RETURNING id), f AS (INSERT INTO finance_transactions (occurred_at, account, scope, direction, amount, currency, counterparty, category, description, source, source_ref) SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF($2,'')::timestamptz, now()), 'office_email', 'office', $18, NULLIF($19,'')::numeric, COALESCE(NULLIF($20,''),'BHD'), NULLIF($21,''), $5, NULLIF($22,''), 'office_email', $1 FROM p WHERE $18 IN ('in','out') AND NULLIF($19,'') IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (source_ref) DO NOTHING RETURNING id) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM p)::int AS saved, (SELECT count(*) FROM t)::int AS task_created, (SELECT count(*) FROM a)::int AS approval_created, (SELECT count(*) FROM f)::int AS tx_created
